name: Anonymous Feedback Collection Widget and Board

mentions.name: Anonymous Feedback Collection Widget and Board
mentions.description: A feedback collection widget and board that lets users submit feedback anonymously, built as a simpler alternative to Canny or UpVote with MCP and API support included from the start. Pricing is $9/mo or $90/yr per project, with a free plan that includes all features capped at 50 feedback items.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got to launch the first one last week; a feedback collection widget and board so users can submit feedback anonymously. Its a simpler version of Canny or UpVote; and with an MCP and API backed in from the get go.
mentions.author: allanmacgregor
